>>> expected_black_ball_position(4, 4)
    592707587
    """
    MOD = 998244353
    inv2 = (MOD + 1) // 2  # 499122177
    # Expected value E_K = ((N+1) - (N-1)*((N-2)/N)^K)/2
    # Compute modulo MOD.
    # For N=1 the second term vanishes (N-1=0), result is 1.
    n_mod = N % MOD
    n_plus_1 = (N + 1) % MOD
    n_minus_1 = (N - 1) % MOD
    inv_n = pow(n_mod, MOD - 2, MOD)
    r = (N - 2) % MOD * inv_n % MOD
    term = pow(r, K, MOD)
    res = (n_plus_1 - n_minus_1 * term) % MOD
    res = res * inv2 % MOD
    return res
